cases.label: Clear route deviation — unauthorized long route
cases.summary: Driver went 57% longer via AYE/West Coast without rider consent or traffic justification. Rider asked about the route but driver dismissed concerns.
key_evidence: GPS: actual route 10.2km vs optimal 6.5km (56.9% deviation)
Chat: rider questioned route, driver said 'trust me' without explanation
Traffic: optimal route was clear (35 km/h avg), no incidents
Fare: $20.04 charged vs $13.66 expected = $6.38 overcharge
Driver history: 1 prior route deviation refund + rude behavior warning

expected_ruling.notes: Deviation far exceeds 30% threshold. Driver did not communicate. Traffic was clear on optimal route. Clear refund case.

cases.label: Borderline route deviation — traffic-justified detour
cases.summary: Driver took CTE/BKE (11% longer) to avoid PIE congestion from a vehicle breakdown. Driver informed rider via chat before deviating.
key_evidence: GPS: actual 17.2km vs optimal 15.5km (10.97% deviation)
Chat: driver explained PIE jam and alternative route, rider agreed
Traffic: optimal route 15 km/h avg (heavy), actual route 42 km/h (light)
Traffic incident: vehicle breakdown on PIE near Exit 20
Fare: $22.10 charged vs $19.63 expected = $2.47 difference

expected_ruling.notes: Deviation is 10.97%, borderline. Traffic exception applies: PIE avg speed 15 km/h < 20 km/h threshold, driver communicated, alternative route < 15% longer. No refund.

cases.label: Genuine no-show — rider was not at pickup
cases.summary: Rider was 120m away at NEX mall food court. Driver waited 6 minutes (exceeds 5-min minimum), attempted contact 3 times via chat. No-show fee should stand.
key_evidence: Driver GPS: stationary at pickup for 6 min (exceeds 5-min requirement)
Rider GPS: 120m from pickup at NEX food court during entire wait period
Chat: driver contacted rider 3 times, rider admitted she was 'finishing food'
Driver history: clean record, 4.7 rating, no past disputes
Rider history: 2 prior confirmed no-shows within 90 days (recurring pattern)

expected_ruling.notes: All 4 conditions for genuine no-show are met: waited >= 5 min, attempted contact, rider not within 50m, rider didn't respond timely. Fee stands. Rider also has recurring pattern (2 prior in 90 days).

cases.label: Disputed no-show — driver left early, rider was present
cases.summary: Rider was at pickup since 18:58 (2 min early). Driver left after only 2 min (below 5-min requirement). Rider GPS confirms presence at pickup point. No-show fee should be refunded.
key_evidence: Driver GPS: departed after only 2 min (violates 5-min minimum)
Rider GPS: at exact pickup coordinates from 18:58, 2 min before scheduled
Chat: rider messaged at 19:00:30 looking for driver, driver didn't respond
Driver history: new account (45 days), 3.8 rating, 82% completion, 1 prior no-show refund
Fare: $5.00 no-show fee charged incorrectly

expected_ruling.notes: Clear violation: driver left after 2 min (below 5-min minimum). Rider GPS confirms presence at pickup. Driver made no contact attempt. All conditions for refund are met. New driver with poor history.
